notes.title: Boink 2.0.0 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hey friends, Boink 2.0.0 is out right now! It is the first feature update since launch. I meant to have this update out way sooner but life can end up being a thing sometimes. Regardless, I hope the new features are enjoyed. See you in the next update!

[b][u]v2.0.0[/u][/b]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Kinetic Bouncer
[*]Combo Bouncer
[*]Build Mode added to Settings
    [list]
    [*]Free Mouse
    [*]Grid Building
    [*]Smart Building[/list]
[*]Visible Grid Lines added to Settings
    [list]
    [*]Only During Build
    [*]Always On
    [*]Always Off[/list]
[*]Ability to multi-purchase Cannon Upgrades
[*]Including being able to hold down to upgrade
[*]New Stat for Highest Collected amount
[/list]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Level size extended to be more square-like
[*]Adds game version number to Settings page
[*]Right and Middle mouse clicks can now power the cannon
[*]Selected Cannon highlight is now more obvious
[*]Directional Bouncers now start with a random direction
[*]Tooltip adjustments for bouncers and bouncer upgrades
[*]Balance changes to account for new bouncers
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Accounts for a save load timing issue with cooldowns & the cooldown reduction upgrade
[*]Rebirth progress bar will now switch back to green after max rebirth
[*]Better input near level edge when setting page is open
[*]Adjusts bouncer circle sprite to be more symmetrical 
[*]Converts Unity Logging to Serilog
[/list]

notes.title: Boink v1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you to all who have purchased Boink, it truly means a lot to me. I come bearing the first patch to the game.

This patch comes with some major changes to gameplay in order to capture a better flow. One of the last features I added to Boink before pushing to Steam was the ability to rebirth more than once at a time. Unfortunately, that meant the mechanic did not have enough time to be gameplay tested, and it led to players being able to purchase multiple if not all rebirth upgrades at once. I wanted rebirths to feel like milestones for the player to hit, so with this patch it will hopefully better balance everything with tweaks to every rebirth upgrade price.

Another change to gameplay is that bouncers now have a starting level cap of 50. This can be increased with a new rebirth upgrade called “Increase Max Bouncer Level”. This gives the player lots of milestones to hit now with trying to max out all the bouncers, and keeps the math from growing out of control very quickly.

Again, thank you for having interest in the game. I look forward to the next updates!
-TheKingOfLettuce
